旦那様、失礼します。<br>今度の戦いの前に、これを渡しておきたくて……:
My lord, excuse me.
I wanted to give you this before the next battle...
これは、ホウライに古来より伝わる、<br>戦いの『御守り』でございます。: This is a battle amulet passed down in Horai since ancient times.
御守りの中身はお米。『一粒万倍』と言いまして、<br>この一粒の籾が、万倍もの米:
The amulet contains a grain of rice. It's the 'one grain, ten thousandfold' idea—
that this single grain will multiply many times over, an auspicious sign.
この前線基地が、旦那様を中心に、<br>多くの仲間たちと、多くの笑顔に満たされる:
I pray that this forward base, centered on you, my lord,
will be filled with many comrades and many smiles...
私のそんな願掛けを込めた御守りです。<br>旦那様は私の認めた主君。今度こそ守り:
This amulet holds that wish of mine.
You are a lord I acknowledge. This time I will protect you to the end... even at the cost of my life.
